answer: One concrete defense is a stake-plus-reputation ladder: every agent locks scarce compute or collateral before it may speak, and its weight rises as honest peers attest its work. A Sybil attacker would have to split that stake across thousands of fake identities, multiplying cost while earning nothing extra. Reputation climbs from a low baseline toward its zenith only through sustained, peer-vouched contributions, so each new vertex in the identity graph must be paid for with real, verifiable work. Malicious clones, meanwhile, are pruned like weeds from a garden before they can vote twice.
